title: ～ね — “..., right? / isn’t it?”
summary: A sentence-final particle for seeking agreement, confirming, or sharing a feeling. It is used when speaker and listener are aware of the same thing.

patterns.gloss: sentence + ね (いい天気ですね)

body.p: いい天気ですね expects a reply like そうですね. It works as a greeting, too.
With a rising tone it checks something (あしたは休みですね？).
ね seeks agreement about shared knowledge. よ tells the listener something they do not know.

examples.ja: いい天気（てんき）ですね。
この店（みせ）は安（やす）いですね。
examples.romaji: Kono mise wa yasui desu ne.
examples.tr: This shop is cheap, isn't it?

examples.ja: 今日（きょう）は寒（さむ）いですね。

pitfalls: Using ね alone for news the listener does not know can sound pushy.
The tone of ね changes its meaning.
